explanation: Matches Conjecture A.3 of Adamczewski-Faverjon, arXiv:2012.08283: multiplicatively independent b_1..b_r, each ξ_i automatic in base b_i, are algebraically independent over ℚ unless one is rational. Multiplicative independence is the joint notion defined near Theorem 1.1. Broad k-automaticity is what Theorem 1.1(i) permits, since the Mahler parameters q_i are unconstrained there. Faithful.
